clips.text_zh: 軟件工程完蛋啦。做了5年標準的後端開發，現在公司準備裁員，唔知我仲有冇前途。😓💻
clips.text_en_b1: Software engineering is doomed. I've been a backend developer for over five years at a small company. Now, they're quietly preparing for layoffs. I get recruiters reaching out, but it feels like the end is near. What's next? 😓
clips.text_en_b2: The situation in software engineering appears dire. Having worked as a backend developer for more than five years at a small firm, I now find myself facing the possibility of layoffs as the company quietly gears up for cutbacks. Although recruiters are reaching out to me, it feels like my career is teetering on the edge. What should I expect next? 😓
clips.text_en_c1: The situation for software engineering appears increasingly dire. Having spent over five years as a backend developer in a modestly sized company, I've recently become aware of impending layoffs being quietly orchestrated. Although recruiters frequently reach out, the looming uncertainty makes me question my future prospects within this industry. It raises pertinent questions: what should my next steps entail? The anxiety surrounding job stability in this field is palpable and deserves serious consideration. 😓
clips.text_en_c2: The outlook for software engineering appears increasingly bleak. Having dedicated over five years to backend development within a modestly sized firm, I am now confronted with the unsettling reality of impending layoffs, which the company is hinting at with quiet resignation. Despite receiving inquiries from recruiters, a sense of dread looms, leading me to question my professional future. What lies ahead in this uncertain landscape? The anxiety is palpable as I ponder my next steps amidst such adversity. 😓💻

clips.text_en_b1: Dynasty Warriors' Cao Pi seems like a more edgelord version of his father without justification. Let's discuss his character compared to other historical figures. Have you guys played this series? Share your thoughts!

Please share your insights and opinions on this topic!

clips.text_zh: 我兩年來一直在做 MMA，最近決定重新開始舉重。希望能維持力量！💪🔥
clips.text_en_b1: I've been training in MMA for two years and recently decided to get back into lifting. I'm focusing on 2-3 times a week full body workouts to build and maintain strength. Let's see how this goes!
clips.text_en_b2: After two years of dedicated MMA training, I've recently made the decision to return to weightlifting. I'm aiming to focus on full-body workouts two to three times a week in order to build and maintain my strength. It will be interesting to see how this approach affects my overall performance! Let's track my progress together! 💪🔥
clips.text_en_c1: For the past two years, I have immersed myself in MMA training, and I have recently chosen to reintegrate weightlifting into my fitness regimen. My current focus is on executing full-body workouts two to three times per week, aimed at both building and maintaining strength. This strategic combination is intended to enhance my overall physical capabilities, and I am eager to observe how this renewed commitment to weight training will impact my performance in MMA. 💪🔥
clips.text_en_c2: For the past two years, I have been immersed in the rigorous training of mixed martial arts, a discipline that has profoundly enriched my life. Recently, I have resolved to reintroduce weightlifting into my routine, aiming for full-body workouts two to three times per week to enhance and sustain my physical strength. This endeavor not only seeks to bolster my MMA performance but also adds an exciting dimension to my training regimen. I eagerly anticipate the results of this renewed commitment! 💪🔥

clips.text_zh: 有冇人覺得近年冇咁多好動畫，有啲我真係希望有多幾季！點睇？
clips.text_en_b1: Does anyone feel like there haven't been many good anime lately? There are some I really wish had more seasons! What do you all think about it?
clips.source_hint: Discussion about anime needing more seasons.
clips.text_en_b2: Does anyone else feel that the quality of anime has dipped significantly in recent years? There are several shows that I genuinely wish had multiple additional seasons! I would love to hear your thoughts on the current state of anime—what are your opinions? Are there certain series you feel deserve more attention?
clips.text_en_c1: Have you noticed a distinct decline in the quality of anime released in recent years? It seems that there are fewer standout titles, and there are specific series that I genuinely wish had been extended for additional seasons. I would love to gather your thoughts on this matter and see if you share similar sentiments. What do you think accounts for this perceived decrease in quality? Let’s engage in a thoughtful discussion about the current state of anime and what we hope to see in the future!
clips.text_en_c2: Is it just me, or does it seem that the past few years have yielded a dearth of exceptional anime productions? There are several series that I genuinely wish had been granted additional seasons, as their narratives and character developments left a significant impact on viewers. I would love to hear your thoughts on this matter; do you share the sentiment that the current anime landscape lacks the quality or quantity it once boasted? Your insights would be invaluable as we engage in this discussion!
